wrvu_state_specialty_median.label: Specialty median work RVU total

visits_specialty_percentile.label: Visits percentile

top_payer_percent_5.help: Share of the clinician's commercial claims.

primary_organization_name.label: Group practice

primary_organization_npi.label: Billing NPI
primary_organization_npi.help: The organization NPI the clinician bills under in claims.

billing_organization_name.label: Bills under
billing_organization_name.help: The organization the clinician bills under in claims.

primary_organization_parent_id.label: Parent organization id
primary_organization_parent_id.help: Identifier of the parent organization of the primary billing organization.

primary_organization_parent_name.label: Parent organization
primary_organization_parent_name.help: Parent organization of the primary billing organization, as recorded in the warehouse.

visits_percent_monday.label: Monday %
visits_percent_monday.help: Share of the clinician's visits that fell on a Monday, by service date. Saturday and Sunday together are the weekend share. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

visits_percent_tuesday.label: Tuesday %

visits_percent_wednesday.label: Wednesday %

visits_percent_thursday.label: Thursday %

visits_percent_friday.label: Friday %

visits_percent_saturday.label: Saturday %

visits_percent_sunday.label: Sunday %

wrvu_prior_year_total.label: Prior-year work RVU total
wrvu_prior_year_total.help: The same work RVU total for the 12 months before the window, Nov 2023 to Oct 2024.

wrvu_prior_year_average.label: Prior-year average work RVU per procedure
wrvu_prior_year_average.help: Prior-year work RVU total divided by prior-year priced procedures, Nov 2023 to Oct 2024.

wrvu_prior_year_procedure_count.label: Prior-year priced procedures
wrvu_prior_year_procedure_count.help: Billed procedure lines that count toward the prior-year total.

wrvu_yoy_change_pct.label: Work RVU change vs prior year
wrvu_yoy_change_pct.help: Percent change of the work RVU total against the prior-year total.

wrvu_state_specialty_average.label: Specialty mean work RVU total
wrvu_state_specialty_average.help: Mean of the per-provider work RVU totals among clinicians in the same specialty statewide. Heavily skewed by a few very high totals; the UI does not show it.

wrvu_state_specialty_median.label: Specialty median work RVU total
wrvu_state_specialty_median.help: The middle value of the per-provider work RVU totals among clinicians in the same specialty statewide.

wrvu_state_specialty_p25.label: Specialty 25th percentile work RVU total
wrvu_state_specialty_p25.help: The per-provider work RVU total at the 25th percentile of the specialty.

wrvu_state_specialty_p75.label: Specialty 75th percentile work RVU total
wrvu_state_specialty_p75.help: The per-provider work RVU total at the 75th percentile of the specialty.

wrvu_state_specialty_npi_count.label: Peers in specialty
wrvu_state_specialty_npi_count.help: Number of same-specialty clinicians in the benchmark peer set: a practice site in the state and at least 50 visits in the window.

wrvu_specialty_percentile.label: Work RVU percentile within specialty
wrvu_specialty_percentile.help: Where the clinician's work RVU total ranks among same-specialty clinicians. 100 is the highest.

visits_specialty_percentile.label: Visits percentile
visits_specialty_percentile.help: Where the clinician's visit count ranks within their specialty. 100 is the highest.

is_primary_member.label: Primary member
is_primary_member.help: On a group member list, whether this organization is the clinician's primary billing organization. Blank outside a group list.

activity_specialty_percentile.label: Activity vs specialty peers (visits and work RVU)
activity_specialty_percentile.help: Combined volume rank within the specialty: the average of the visits percentile and the work RVU percentile. A volume rank.

group_size.label: Group size
group_size.help: Largest CMS-reported group size among members.

telehealth_offered.label: Telehealth offered
telehealth_offered.help: At least one member reports offering telehealth to CMS.

visits_new_patient.label: New patient visits
visits_new_patient.help: Office visits billed as new-patient evaluation and management.

visits_established.label: Established visits
visits_established.help: Office visits billed as established-patient evaluation and management.

visits_percent_new_patient.label: New patient %
visits_percent_new_patient.help: New-patient share of office evaluation and management visits. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

visits_percent_office.label: Office
visits_percent_office.help: Share of visits in a physician office. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

visits_percent_hopd.label: Hospital outpatient
visits_percent_hopd.help: Share of visits in a hospital outpatient department. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

visits_percent_asc.label: Ambulatory surgery
visits_percent_asc.help: Share of visits in an ambulatory surgery center. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

visits_percent_ed.label: Emergency
visits_percent_ed.help: Share of visits in an emergency department. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

visits_percent_telehealth.label: Telehealth
visits_percent_telehealth.help: Share of visits delivered by telehealth. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

visits_percent_inpatient.label: Inpatient
visits_percent_inpatient.help: Share of visits in an inpatient hospital setting. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

visits_percent_lab.label: Laboratory

visits_percent_other_pos.label: Other settings
visits_percent_other_pos.help: Share of visits in any other place of service. On the group page this is weighted across members by their visits.

mips_final_score.label: MIPS final score
mips_final_score.help: CMS Merit-based Incentive Payment System final score, latest published year.

open_payments_year.label: Open Payments year

practices.label: Sites
practices.help: Up to 5 practice locations ranked by the clinician's visits there, from claims.

group_practices.label: Group practices
group_practices.help: The clinician's group practice from the master reference file, then every group the CMS reassignment file lists for them.

hospital_affiliations.label: Facility affiliations (not shown)
hospital_affiliations.help: Not shown in the UI. A visit-based grouping of facilities whose parent grouping data is not reliable enough to display.

referrals.label: Referrals
referrals.help: Top 5 clinicians whose patients went on to see this clinician, and top 5 this clinician's patients went on to see. The warehouse infers these from the sequence of visits, so they are shared-patient flow rather than written referral orders. Clinicians in the same organization, and pathology, radiology, anesthesia and lab clinicians, are left out.

practice_name.label: Primary site
practice_name.help: Name of the clinician's primary practice site.

city.label: City
city.help: City of the clinician's primary practice site.

state.label: State
state.help: State of the clinician's primary practice site.

organization_id.label: Group practice id
organization_id.help: Identifier of the group in the master reference file (the CMS group PAC ID). Members are the clinicians whose group practice this is.

organization_npi.label: Billing NPI
organization_npi.help: One of the organization NPIs the members bill under in claims.

parent_id.label: Parent organization id
parent_id.help: Identifier of the group's parent organization.

parent_name.help: Parent organization of the group: the one most of its member clinicians are recorded under.

active_provider_count.help: Members with at least one visit or panel patient in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

in_system_provider_count.help: Members with a CMS hospital affiliation.

visits_per_provider.label: Visits per clinician
visits_per_provider.help: Group visits divided by number of member clinicians.

visits_percentile.help: Where this group's visit total ranks among all groups. 100 is the highest.

activity_percentile.label: Activity percentile
activity_percentile.help: Where this group's visits per clinician ranks among all groups. 100 is the highest.

visits_are_summed_across_npis.label: Summed across clinicians
visits_are_summed_across_npis.help: Volume on this page is summed across member clinicians.

member_count_any.label: Clinicians billing here
member_count_any.help: Number of clinicians with any billing under this organization in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025, primary or not. The totals on this page use only primary members.

npi.help: The clinician this site belongs to.

site_rank.label: Rank
site_rank.help: Site order by the clinician's visits there. 1 is the primary site.

sl_code.help: Warehouse code of the busiest location in this site.

cluster_key.label: Site key

name.label: Site name

longitude.help: Longitude of the site, unused by the UI in v1.

visits_at_site.help: The clinician's visits at this site in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

visit_share_pct.help: Share of the clinician's visits that happened at this site. Sites past the top 5 and visits with no location keep the shares from adding to 100.

npi_type.help: Whether the location code is an organization (2) or an individual (1).

location_source.label: Location source
location_source.help: Where the address came from. Always claims today.

location_flag.label: Location status
location_flag.help: Confidence flag for the address. Always claims-confirmed today.

phone_source.label: Phone source
phone_source.help: Where the phone came from: CMS PDC, or blank.

needs_geocode.label: Needs geocode

wrvu_at_site.help: The clinician's work RVU total over procedures billed at this site.

wrvu_share_pct.label: Share of work RVU at site
wrvu_share_pct.help: This site's part of the clinician's work RVU total.

billing_type.help: R: the master reference file's group practice. C: a CMS reassignment group.

max_period_code.label: Last month billed
max_period_code.help: Blank: billing months are not available from the reference sources.

npi.help: The clinician this affiliation belongs to.

affiliation_rank.label: Rank
affiliation_rank.help: Not shown in the UI. Affiliated organizations ordered by the clinician's visits there, at most 5.

hospital_system_name.label: Affiliated organization (not shown)
hospital_system_name.help: Not shown in the UI. Parent organization of the facilities where the clinician's visits took place; facilities of one parent are combined.

facility_name.label: Facility
facility_name.help: The busiest facility within the organization, when it has its own name.

visits_at_system.help: The clinician's visits across all sites of this organization in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

visit_share_pct.label: Visit share
visit_share_pct.help: Share of the clinician's visits that took place at this organization.

provider_count.label: Clinicians
provider_count.help: On a group page, number of member clinicians affiliated with this organization.

npi.help: The clinician this referral row belongs to.

direction.label: Direction
direction.help: in: clinicians whose patients went on to see this clinician. out: clinicians this clinician's patients went on to see.

peer_rank.label: Rank
peer_rank.help: Top 5 per direction by patients, after leaving out clinicians in the same billing organization and pathology, radiology, anesthesiology and lab clinicians.

peer_npi.label: Peer NPI
peer_npi.help: NPI of the referring or receiving clinician.

peer_name.label: Peer
peer_name.help: Name of the referring or receiving clinician.

peer_specialty.label: Peer specialty
peer_specialty.help: Specialty of the referring or receiving clinician.

patient_count.label: Patients
patient_count.help: Patients who saw both clinicians in sequence in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025, as inferred by the warehouse from visit order. Monthly counts are summed, so a patient counted in three months counts three times.

claim_count.label: Claims
claim_count.help: Claims behind the referral relationship in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

npi.label: NPI
npi.help: The clinician this utilization row belongs to.

rk.label: Rank
rk.help: Procedure categories ordered by CMS percentile.

count_label.label: Volume
count_label.help: CMS volume label for the category.

specialty.help: Clinicians whose specialty code matches, or whose specialty description contains the text.

organization.label: Organization contains
organization.help: Clinicians whose primary billing organization name contains the text.

organization_id.help: Clinicians whose primary billing organization has this id.

city.label: City contains
city.help: Clinicians whose main practice site is in a city containing the text.

active.label: Active only
active.help: Show only clinicians with at least one visit or panel patient in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025. Unchecked, the list includes clinicians with no claims activity in the window.

in_system.label: In-system only
in_system.help: Show only clinicians with a facility affiliation on file with CMS.

min_visits.label: Minimum visits
min_visits.help: Lower bound on the clinician's visits in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025. The default of 1 leaves out clinicians who only appear as referring physicians.

max_visits.label: Maximum visits
max_visits.help: Upper bound on the clinician's visits in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025. Set it equal to the minimum for an exact count.

membership.label: Membership
membership.help: With an organization id: primary lists clinicians whose primary billing organization is the group; any lists every clinician with billing under the group in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

organization.label: Organization contains
organization.help: Groups whose name contains the text.

organization_id.label: Organization id
organization_id.help: One group by its exact billing organization id.

parent.label: Parent organization contains
parent.help: Groups whose parent organization name contains the text.

active.label: Roll up active providers only
active.help: Count and sum only member clinicians with activity in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025. Unchecked, every member counts, active or not, so visits and clinician counts can be higher.

in_system.label: Has in-system providers
in_system.help: Show only groups with at least one member who has a facility affiliation on file with CMS.

min_visits.label: Minimum visits
min_visits.help: Lower bound on the group's visits in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025, summed across member clinicians.

max_visits.label: Maximum visits
max_visits.help: Upper bound on the group's summed visits in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

min_providers.label: Minimum clinicians
min_providers.help: Show only groups with at least this many member clinicians in the chosen roll-up.

volume.label: Volume
volume.help: Visits, panel size and work RVU for the clinician in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.

work_rvu_vs_specialty.label: Work RVU vs specialty

standing.label: Standing
standing.help: Where the clinician ranks among specialty peers on visits and on activity.

office_em_visits.label: Office visits
office_em_visits.help: New and established patient office visits, from the office evaluation and management codes.

place_of_service.label: Place of service
place_of_service.help: Share of the clinician's visits by care setting.

visits_by_day.label: Visits by day of week
visits_by_day.help: Share of the clinician's visits on each weekday.

top_diagnoses.label: Top diagnoses
top_diagnoses.help: The five diagnoses most often on the clinician's visits, with each one's share of visits.

top_procedures.label: Top procedures
top_procedures.help: The five procedure codes most often billed on the clinician's visits, with each one's share of visits.

top_primary_procedures.label: Top primary procedures
top_primary_procedures.help: The five procedures with a physician work RVU above 1 most often billed by the clinician, leaving out office visits, exams, therapy evaluations, psychotherapy and lab panels. Empty for clinicians who bill only visit-type services.

group_practices.label: Group practices
group_practices.help: The clinician's group practice from the master reference file, then every group the CMS reassignment file lists for them.

group_source_R.label: Master reference file
group_source_R.help: Group practice recorded for the clinician in the master reference file.

group_source_C.label: CMS reassignment
group_source_C.help: A group the clinician reassigns Medicare benefits to, from the CMS reassignment file.

referrals.help: Clinicians whose patients went on to see this clinician, and clinicians this clinician's patients went on to see, top 5 each. Same-organization, pathology, radiology, anesthesia and lab clinicians are left out.

referrals_in.label: Referrals in
referrals_in.help: Clinicians whose patients went on to see this clinician.

referrals_out.label: Referrals out
referrals_out.help: Clinicians this clinician's patients went on to see.

sites.label: Sites
sites.help: The clinician's top five practice locations by visits, named from the location's DBA or registered name, else its address.

panel.label: Panel
panel.help: Age and sex of the clinician's patients, and the payers behind their visits.

payer_mix.label: Payer mix

top_commercial_payers.label: Top commercial payers
top_commercial_payers.help: The five commercial payers with the most of the clinician's commercial claims, each as a share of commercial claims.

cms.label: CMS
cms.help: Group size, telehealth, secondary specialties and MIPS scores as published by CMS.

group_page_note.label: Summed across clinicians

clinicians.label: Clinicians
clinicians.help: How many clinicians belong to the group, how many were active in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025, how many have a CMS facility affiliation, and visits per clinician.

volume.help: Visits, panel size and work RVU summed across the group's member clinicians in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025. An encounter billed by two members counts twice.

work_rvu_vs_specialty.label: Work RVU vs specialty
work_rvu_vs_specialty.help: Not shown on a group page: specialty benchmarks are per clinician.

standing.label: Standing
standing.help: Where the group ranks among all groups in the state on total visits and on visits per clinician.

office_em_visits.label: Office visits
office_em_visits.help: New and established patient office visits summed across member clinicians.

place_of_service.label: Place of service
place_of_service.help: Share of the members' visits by care setting, weighted by each member's visits.

visits_by_day.label: Visits by day of week
visits_by_day.help: Share of the members' visits on each weekday, weighted by each member's visits.

top_diagnoses.help: The five diagnoses most often on members' visits, summed from each member's own top five. Shares are a lower bound of the group-wide share.

top_procedures.label: Top procedures
top_procedures.help: The five procedure codes most often billed by members, summed from each member's own top five. Shares are a lower bound.

top_primary_procedures.label: Top primary procedures
top_primary_procedures.help: The five procedures with a physician work RVU above 1 most often billed by members, summed from each member's own top five; office visits, exams, therapy evaluations, psychotherapy and lab panels left out.

group_practices.label: Group practices
group_practices.help: Not shown on a group page.

referrals.label: Referrals
referrals.help: Clinicians whose patients went on to see a member of the group, and clinicians the members' patients went on to see, top 5 each, summed across members. Inferred by the warehouse from the sequence of visits. Members of the group, same-organization peers, and pathology, radiology, anesthesia and lab clinicians are left out.

referrals_in.label: Referrals in
referrals_in.help: Clinicians whose patients went on to see a member of the group.

referrals_out.label: Referrals out
referrals_out.help: Clinicians the members' patients went on to see.

sites.label: Sites
sites.help: The five locations with the most member visits, with visits and work RVU summed across members at each.

panel.label: Panel
panel.help: Age and sex of the members' patients, weighted by each member's visits, and the payers behind their visits.

payer_mix.label: Payer mix
payer_mix.help: Share of members' claims by payer class, weighted by each member's visits. Other is outside the denominator.

top_commercial_payers.label: Top commercial payers
top_commercial_payers.help: The five commercial payers with the most of the members' commercial claims, each as a share of the group's commercial claims.

cms.label: CMS
cms.help: Group size as published by CMS, and whether any member offers telehealth.

modal_specialty.label: Most common specialty
modal_specialty.help: The specialty with the most member visits. A multispecialty group shows its busiest specialty here.
